home.introP2: We make travel planning feel less like a chore and more like the first step of your adventure. Whether you're dreaming of a lazy beach day, wine tasting in Tuscany, or a passport full of stamps, we're here to make it easy, exciting, and 100% you.

about.storyP1: Founded in 1994, Palmer Travel began with a singular belief: that travel is not a commodity, but a collection of carefully curated chapters. What started as a small boutique consultancy in a sun-drenched coastal town has evolved into a global authority on high-end leisure.
about.storyP2: We don't just book flights or reserve suites. We curate environments. Our founders, seasoned explorers themselves, realized that the best memories aren't found in a brochure, but in the quiet moments between the landmarks—the scent of a lemon grove in Sorrento, the silence of a desert night in Namibia.
about.storyQuote: "We are not travel agents. We are storytellers whose ink is the horizon."
about.val1Desc: We believe in travel that respects the soul of a destination. Our sustainability mission ensures that the beauty we share today remains for the voyagers of tomorrow.
about.val2Desc: Exceptional travel feels effortless. We work behind the scenes to orchestrate every detail, so you can remain entirely present in your journey.
about.val3Desc: We prioritize local heritage over generic luxury. Our connections grant access to the hidden doorways and private tables of the world.
about.why1Desc: No two itineraries are identical. Each trip is hand-stitched to your specific tastes, rhythms, and dreams.
about.why2Desc: From missed connections to last-minute inspirations, our team is available across every time zone to handle the unexpected.
about.why3Desc: We hold keys to private villas, sold-out events, and remote sanctuaries that aren't available to the general public.
about.ctaSubtitle: Our curators are waiting to design your most memorable story yet.
